description: This file defines a FastAPI router for managing a shopping cart, including endpoints for getting cart details, adding, updating, removing, and clearing items from a user's cart. It interacts with cart storage and product services.

methods.name: str get_user_id(x_user_id: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-User-Id"))
methods.description: Extracts the user ID from the X-User-Id header, raising an HTTP 400 error if not provided.

methods.name: CartResponse _build_cart_response(user_id: str)
methods.description: Constructs and returns a CartResponse object containing the current items in the user's cart with computed subtotal and total.

methods.name: CartResponse get_cart(user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id))
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve the complete cart details for the user.

methods.name: None add_or_increment_cart( product_id: int = Path(..., description="Product ID to add/increment in cart"), body: dict = Body({}, example={"quantity": 1}), user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id), )
methods.description: API endpoint to add a product to the cart or increment its quantity.

methods.name: None patch_cart_quantity( product_id: int = Path(..., description="Product ID"), req: UpdateQuantityRequest = Body(...), user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id), )
methods.description: API endpoint to set a specific product's quantity in the cart.

methods.name: None remove_cart_item( product_id: int = Path(..., description="Product ID"), user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id), )
methods.description: API endpoint to remove a specific product from the cart.

methods.name: None clear_cart_items(user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id))
methods.description: API endpoint to clear all items from the user's cart.

ctags.signature: ( product_id: int = Path(..., description="Product ID to add/increment in cart"), body: dict = Body({}, example={"quantity": 1}), user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id), )

ctags.pattern: /^def get_user_id(x_user_id: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-User-Id")) -> str:$/
